retrievalProfile.description: A dreamy, low-contrast beach sunset featuring large-scale 3D glass-textured typography that uses the background image as its fill.
triggerTerms: ethereal beach sunset with 3D glass text
pastel ocean landscape with transparent extruded lettering
excludeWhen: dark or moody night scenes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A serene, overexposed beach scene at sunset with soft pastel tones, overlaid with massive, semi-transparent 3D block lettering that creates a refractive glass effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of large-scale display type
Harmony between warm sun highlights and cool ocean shadows
Soft horizon line bisecting the composition
coreInvariants: Text fill derived from the background image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The typography is the primary subject, scaled to fill the majority of the frame from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central horizontal line of text ('Good-ass') acts as the primary anchor, spanning the width of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left 'The', down through the central large text, to the bottom 'Vol. 1', following a vertical scan.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the text occupies approximately 70% of the visual field.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pale peach and soft cream (sky and sand)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted blue and lavender (ocean waves and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation across the entire image to create a washed-out, ethereal look.

letterConstructionRules: Significant 3D extrusion with a slight downward-right perspective
Beveled edges to catch light highlights
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a wide, circular counter
The '1' is a simple slab-like block

typesetting.case: Sentence case for main title, All-caps for metadata

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and 3D treatments.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D effect to be visible.
Geometric qualities match the modern, clean aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed photograph of a beach at sunset with soft pastel colors (peach, cream, light blue) and a gentle sun flare on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large-scale 3D extruded sans-serif text. The text should be semi-transparent, using the background image as a fill, with a subtle white inner glow on the edges to simulate glass.

verificationChecks: Is the overall image low-contrast and pastel?
Does the text use the background as its fill?
Is the typography the dominant element?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth consistency across all letters
Ensure the sun flare doesn't obscure the text legibility
Verify the pastel color balance is maintained
Confirm the text fill correctly masks the background
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key beach sunset + Massive 3D glass-refractive sans-serif typography = Ethereal Summer Aesthetic
